Clear by design

Site information & privacy.

Who publishes this site?

honeybees.consulting is the consulting brand presented by Daksh Mehta, based in Paris, France.

For questions about the website or your information, write to dakshmehta077@gmail.com.

The contact form stays on your device.

The contact form prepares an email draft in your own email app. Nothing you type there is sent to or saved by this website. The calculator on the archived first version of the site also runs only in your browser.

When you choose to send an email, its contents are handled by your email provider and the recipient’s email service. Daksh uses enquiry information to respond and discuss the requested work. You can contact him to ask about or request deletion of that correspondence.

The honeybees letter.

If you subscribe, your email address, your language, the page you signed up on and the date are stored in a Google Sheet that only Daksh can open. Google receives them through a Google Apps Script form handler and processes them on his behalf. Your address is used only to send the letter and is never shared or sold.

To unsubscribe or have your address deleted, reply to any letter or write to the address above. You can also ask what we hold about you.

Preferences and analytics.

The site remembers your language and calm-mode choices in your browser’s local storage (honeybee-language, honeybee-motion), and that you have seen the opening animation in session storage (honeybee-loaded). You can clear them in your browser’s site-data settings. No analytics, advertising pixels or tracking cookies are added by this site. Fonts and images are hosted with the site.

Hosting and external links.

The site is hosted on GitHub Pages. Hosting providers may process connection information such as IP addresses and request logs to operate their services. External resource links take you to other websites, which have their own privacy policies.

GitHub’s privacy statement ↗︎

Illustrations and logos.

The bees, hives and flowers are original vector illustrations made for this site. Framework and tool logos belong to their owners. They name the standards and tools we work with and do not imply an accreditation, partnership or guaranteed assessment result.

Discussing a project.

Sending an enquiry does not create a consulting agreement. Scope, deliverables, schedule, pricing and any information-sharing arrangements are agreed separately before a project begins.

Last updated: 15 October 2026
